Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CURSOR c_ord IS SELECT status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 r_ord orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.short_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 OPEN c_ord;
 FETCH c_ord INTO :ctrl.short_status;
 CLOSE c_ord;
 :ctrl.short_status := r_ord.status;
 :ctrl.short_status := NVL(r_ord.status, '-');
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.default_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.wide_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.count_id FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.status_list FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.bare_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 read_status(1, :ctrl.short_status);
 SELECT status INTO :only_here FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :dup FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :nope.z FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :parameter.p_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :global.last_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 SELECT status INTO :system.message_level FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: READ_ONE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION read_one RETURN varchar2 IS
 l varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 SELECT status INTO l FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
 RETURN l;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_ONE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE show_one IS
 l_status varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 l_status := read_one;
 :ctrl.default_status := read_one;
 SELECT status INTO :ctrl.status_image FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1;
END;
